unverified.reason: No source gives the coefficient of a part on the ground (NAVFAC DM 7.02 Table 1 gives 0.20 to 0.60 for steel and concrete against soils, but not for the parts the user builds). Nominal and spread are soil friction angles used as a proxy, so both badges are estimate, and the proxy is an upper bound for smooth parts (grip biased high). Which ground the user stands on (grass, sand, clay, pavement) is unknown to the model.
